title: Basic Formulas and Geometry
summary: This material reviews basic formulas for area, volume, and speed involving length, width, height, distance, and time.

concepts.name: Area
concepts.summary: Area is calculated as the product of length and width.

concepts.name: Volume
concepts.summary: Volume is calculated as the product of length, width, and height.

concepts.name: Speed
concepts.summary: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time.
